newsitem.title: USA: Applied Magnetics off on Montgomery concerns.
newsitem.headline: Applied Magnetics off on Montgomery concerns.

text.p: Shares of Applied Magnetics Corp dropped about 11 percent on Wednesday after a Montgomery Securities analyst cited concerns about the firm's manufacturing production, traders said.

"There's some worries about the Montgomery report, which said they had concerns about production yields," one trader said. Production yields refers to the amount of usable product emerging from a manufacturing line.
Montgomery analyst Paul Fox was traveling and could not be reached for comment, his office said. Applied Magnetics, based in Goleta, Calif., did not return calls seeking comment.
Applied Magnetics, which supplies recording heads for computer disk and tape drives, fell 3-1/4 to 26-1/4 and was among the most active stocks on the New York Stock Exchange.
Other disk drive makers were weak on Wednesday. Seagate Technology Inc fell 1-5/8 to 48-5/8, Western Digital fell 3-3/8 to 64-1/4 and Quantum Corp eased 1-1/2 to 44.
